title.zh: HOPE 全球积分体系 · 规则

intro.zh: HOPE 积分参照网球 ATP 巡回赛体系设计：每站赛事按级别设定分值，名次越高积分越多。北京站为 HOPE 250 级别。
intro.en: HOPE points follow the structure of tennis' ATP Tour: every event carries a tier that sets its points, and higher placings earn more. Beijing is a HOPE 250 event.

note.zh: 网球没有三四名决赛，两名半决赛负者同得 100 分；HOPE 设第三名赛，因此在不改变总分的前提下拆分，胜方 +10
note.en: Tennis has no third-place match, so both losing semi-finalists take 100. HOPE does play one, so the 200 is split without changing the total: +10 to the winner
The other half of the split: −10. 110 + 90 = 100 + 100, so the total is unchanged

note.zh: 与 ATP 250 相同，四队并列
note.en: Same as ATP 250; four teams tied

note.zh: 与 ATP 250 相同，未来扩大签表时适用
note.en: Same as ATP 250; applies if the draw expands

note.zh: 两列相等 —— HOPE 的拆分不改变积分总量，与 ATP 体系保持可比
note.en: The columns match: HOPE's split does not change the total, keeping it comparable with the ATP system

desc.zh: 首届 / 新设站点（2026 北京站即此档）
世界人形机器人运动会正赛等最高级别
desc.en: Highest tier, e.g. the World Humanoid Robot Games main competition

footnotes.zh: 分值依据 ATP 巡回赛 2026 积分表。
footnotes.en: Values follow the ATP Tour 2026 points table.

footnotes.zh: 第三名赛 110 / 90 的拆分为 HOPE 自定规则，目前为 v0.1 草案，须经组委会核准后生效。
footnotes.en: The 110 / 90 split for the third-place match is a HOPE-specific rule, currently a v0.1 draft pending approval by the organising committee.

notes.zh: 本站为 HOPE 250 级别：冠军 250 分，亚军 165 分，第三名 110 分，第四名 90 分，5–8 名各 50 分。
notes.en: Beijing is a HOPE 250 event: 250 points for the champion, 165 for the runner-up, 110 for third, 90 for fourth and 50 each for places 5–8.

notes.zh: 名次以组委会公布的赛果为准；冠亚军另见新华网、央视网 2026 年 8 月报道。
notes.en: Placings follow the results published by the organising committee; the top two are also reported by Xinhuanet and CCTV, August 2026.
